speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing right groin pain and have an abnormal leg positioning following a rear-end collision. To assess the extent of your injury, can you tell me if you heard a "pop" at the time of the accident, and are you currently unable to bear weight on that leg?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bilateral knee dislocations with associated right hip dislocation.
